_doc: Surface -> drift-sentinel manifest for the merge-time impacted-test gate. Each entry maps a SURFACE GLOB (repo-relative, '**' = any depth, '*' = one path segment) to the drift-sentinel test file(s) that guard that surface. A drift sentinel AST/rglob-scans a whole source tree (or a fixed source-file set) and compares it against a stored __fixtures__/*.json (or snapshot) — it never imports the app modules it guards, so impacted_tests.py's dotted-import reverse-dep scan cannot select it. Without this manifest such a sentinel runs only in the full promotion suite, so a drift-introducing change (e.g. a new websocket emitter or event_type) merges green on the task PR and only breaks weeks later at the automain->main promotion matrix. Registration here makes impacted_tests.resolve_impacted() select the sentinel whenever a changed path matches its surface. Choose globs conservatively: a whole-tree glob fires on every PR touching that tree (acceptable for a fast source-scan sentinel), but scope to specific files when the sentinel only scans a fixed source-file set.

surfaces.why: test_websocket_emitter_inventory.py AST-scans the ENTIRE backend/app tree (read_app_sources -> app_dir.rglob('*.py')) against __fixtures__/websocket_event_inventory_v1.json and imports only backend/testing helpers, so a new emitter in any app module never selects it by import. test_direction_referential_guard.py rglobs the whole app tree for new Direction.criterion_keys writers (against KNOWN_GUARDED_WRITERS); it imports app.direction_referential_guard, so it is only import-selectable when THAT module changes, never when a new writer appears in an unrelated file. Both must run whenever any app source changes. (test_websocket_emitter_inventory.py is ALSO in scripts/test-backend.sh STANDALONE_ARGS; this registration is additive and complementary.)

test_event_type_invariants.py regex-extracts event_type="..." literals from a FIXED source-file set and compares them against event_type_snapshot.json. It reads the files by path (never imports the modules), so a new/renamed event_type merges undetected unless the sentinel is selected. It is NOT in STANDALONE_ARGS. Scoped to the exact files the sentinel scans rather than the whole tree so it does not fire on every app PR.
Second source file in test_event_type_invariants.py's fixed source_paths set (event_type literals for capability trial verdicts). Same rationale as backend/app/notification_dispatch.py.

test_migration_chain.py::test_migration_files_do_not_import_app_modules AST-scans every migration file in alembic/versions/ for app.* imports — a class of defect (#15100, 0621/0626) that causes ImportError in the promotion apply gate when migration files are executed in the serving process. Migration files never import backend/testing helpers and are not in backend/app/, so the dotted-import reverse-dep scan never selects this guard. Register here so any change to a migration file runs the guard at merge time.

test_migration_0621_safe_encrypt_backfill.py loads the migration via importlib rather than importing it as an app.* module, so the dotted-import reverse-dep scan cannot select it. Register here so that changes to the migration body (e.g. inlining field_encryption helpers) cause the acceptance tests to run at the task PR rather than only at the promotion matrix.
Same rationale as 0621: test_migration_0626_safe_encrypt_backfill.py loads the migration via importlib; register here so migration body changes trigger the acceptance tests at the task PR.
